findings.root_cause_confirmed: Pressing only STM32 physical RESET leaves ESP32 continuously powered on. ESP32 retains stale software RTC. When STM32 boots and queries AT+SYSTIMESTAMP?, ESP32 immediately replies with stale timestamp, which fails sntp_time_consistent against fresh NTP packet (reason=10).
findings.proven_mitigation: Cold USB unplug/replug resets both STM32 and ESP32 simultaneously, guaranteeing 100% clean cold SNTP sync as observed in Attempt 2.
